_readme: Stage-advance moments per NPC per stage. Triggered when an NPC's stage increases. Stage index matches NPC_DEFS.stages (0=Stranger, 1=Acquaintance, 2=Friend, 3=Open, 4=Studying, 5=Believer). Index 0 is never used (it's the starting stage, not an advancement).

kenji.1: Kenji nods at you across the station platform now. He remembers your face.
kenji.2: Kenji is no longer formal with you. He stays longer, talks more, lets things slip.
kenji.3: Kenji has started asking real questions — the kind you only ask people you trust.
kenji.4: Kenji has asked to read scripture with you. He brings a notebook and writes everything down.
kenji.5: Kenji has put his trust in Christ. He says it quietly, like he's afraid of breaking something. The first of many, you pray.

yuki.1: Yuki LINEs you a question from her notebook. The first of many.
yuki.2: Yuki shows up to events with friends now. She's introducing you.
yuki.3: Yuki has started reading the Bible — Japanese and English side by side. She has questions she's been saving.
yuki.4: Yuki is studying the Gospel of John with you weekly. She marks every page.
yuki.5: Yuki believes. 'God couldn't just send a message,' she says. 'He had to come.' She understands the Incarnation in a way that undoes her.

hiro.1: Hiro brings you coffee from the vending machine without asking now. He pays.
hiro.2: Hiro tells you Emiko's name. He tells you she prayed.
hiro.3: Hiro has asked you if the dead can hear us. He wasn't asking philosophically.
hiro.4: Hiro is reading Emiko's Bible with you. He keeps her bookmarks where she left them.
hiro.5: Hiro asked you to pray out loud. He closed his eyes. 'I think she prayed like that,' he said.
